item.title: Bellevue, WA clinic uses magnetic therapy to treat depression
item.description: A clinic in Bellevue talks about transcranial magnetic stimulation. The new technology is becoming more widely available to the general public to treat depression and OCD.

item.title: Redmond business owner begs for bollards in saga of smash-and-grabs
item.description: A Redmond business owner said thieves have targeted his store over and over again, smashing through the storefront and leaving a major mess. Now, he's calling for action.

item.title: Seattle weather: Drier Friday and Saturday
item.description: Western Washington will be much drier Friday and Saturday as a ridge of high pressures settles in over the Pacific Northwest.

item.title: Debate over taxes, spending will dominate WA's 2026 legislative session
item.description: Washington’s 2026 legislative session begins Monday, with lawmakers facing major debates over taxes, spending, and how to balance a $79 billion two-year budget.

item.title: Demond Williams Jr. reverses course, announces return to University of Washington
item.description: Two days after shocking the University of Washington by announcing his plans to enter the transfer portal, Demond Williams Jr. announced he will be staying at the school for the 2026 season.

item.title: WA man faces murder charges for death of missing Bothell woman
item.description: A Bremerton man is being held on no bail, suspected in the death of a missing Bothell woman.

item.title: 3 measles cases confirmed in family visiting western WA for holidays
item.description: Health officials confirmed three measles cases in a family visiting western Washington during the holidays, with possible exposures in Snohomish and King counties.

item.title: Seattle Mariners avoid salary arbitration with six players
item.description: The Seattle Mariners reached agreements with six players to avoid salary arbitration hearings ahead of Thursday's deadline, including Logan Gilbert, Randy Arozarena, and George Kirby.

item.title: Hundreds attend Seattle vigil for woman shot by ICE in Minnesota
item.description: Around 500 people gathered in Seattle for a vigil to remember Renee Good, the U.S. citizen shot and killed by ICE in Minnesota on Wednesday.

item.title: Seattle Kraken extend points streak to 10 games, lose 3-2 to Wild in overtime
item.description: Mats Zuccarello scored off a feed from Kirill Kaprizov on a rush at 2:09 of overtime, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Seattle Kraken 3-2 on Thursday night to finish a two-week, seven-game trip.
